description: This Java class provides utility functions for handling Single Sign-On (SSO) operations within the Nextcloud Notes Android client, including prompting for account selection and checking account configuration status.

classes.name: SSOUtil
classes.description: A utility class for managing Nextcloud SSO operations such as prompting for account selection and verifying account configuration.

methods.name: askForNewAccount
methods.description: Prompts the user to select or add a new Nextcloud account, handling exceptions related to app installation and permissions.

methods.name: isConfigured
methods.description: Checks whether a valid Nextcloud account is currently configured on the device.
